title: Exercise for the lazy
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What is the minimum amount of exercise that still makes a meaningful difference to health?
Why do people avoid exercise even when they know it will make them feel better afterwards?
Is it better for an inactive person to walk daily or start a more intense programme?
How could exercise be made easier to fit into ordinary routines rather than treated as a separate hobby?
What form of movement feels least like 'exercise' to you?
